description: Vendor STEP as shipped: 'NSP-1600_0417.stp'. 1600 W enclosed AC/DC supply, Case No. 296A, 300 x 85 x 41 mm, 1.8 kg, two 40 mm exhaust fans at one end, AC terminal block + two DC busbar blades + signal headers at the other. Nothing here is fabricated by us; this directory exists so mounts can be designed against exact vendor geometry.

bottom_m3.measured: extruded holes in the 1.2 mm bottom sheet, minor dia 2.65, ~1.6-2.1 mm of thread; PCB underside 4.5 mm above the outer face

side_m4.measured: Y = 348.352: a dia 4.54 threaded cross-tube (minor 3.1) spanning the width - real. Y = 96.352: a dia 5.0 clearance opening in each wall with NOTHING behind it - the thread is not modelled. Verify on a unit.

side_pins_do_not_use.note: Vendor assembly features (the terminal-end pair has the end plate's 0.8 mm flange behind it). Not fixings.

faces.bottom_minus_z: flat, 21819 mm2 (shell) + 630 mm2 (fan bracket) at Z = 1.5; carries only the 3 M3 and two flush countersunk vendor screws
faces.top_plus_z: removable cover, 24462 mm2 at Z = 42.5, zero openings, no fixings
faces.sides_plus_minus_x: 1.2 mm shell walls at X = 24.287 / 109.287; 14-16 flush countersunk vendor screw mouths each, the 2 M4 and 2 dia 2.8 per side; NO vents
faces.fan_end_minus_y: fan guard at Y = 53.552 over two 40 x 40 x 28 fans; EXHAUST
faces.terminal_end_plus_y: end plate at Y = 354.15: 14 intake louvres 8 x 5.5 + 5 slots 8 x 1.6, AC terminal block (M3.5, proud to 362.11), two 2 mm DC blades proud to 392.152 (38 mm) and 382.10 (28 mm) each with a dia 6.5 lug hole, CN1 16-way and CN2 8-way DF11 headers, LED, trim pot

features.airflow: in at the terminal-face louvres, out through the fans (datasheet air-flow arrow)

notes: 19 solids: shell, PCB, 2 fans, top cover, AC block, fan bracket, 2 blades, end plate, 9 terminal/connector solids. No threads, no PMI.

Every number above was measured from this file with lib/analyze_step.py and axial/ring probes and cross-checked against the Case No. 296A drawing (datasheets/NSP-1600-SPEC.pdf); every hole agrees to 0.002 mm.
Only the HORIZONTAL attitude is qualified - the derating curve carries no other label and the installation manual defers to the spec sheet for anything else.
Design mass 1.8 kg (datasheet). Vibration qualification 10-500 Hz, 2 G.
